text: {"headline":"4 of 19 open findings need action now.","paragraphs":["We scanned shop-api and report-worker. 19 findings are open. 4 need action now because they are on the known-exploited list or are rated Critical with a high estimated chance of exploitation. 3 more belong in this sprint.","The most urgent are CVE-2022-22817 in Pillow (severity Critical, EPSS 0.60; upgrade Pillow to 9.0.0), CVE-2020-14343 in PyYAML (severity Critical, in KEV, EPSS 0.45; upgrade PyYAML to 5.4), GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm in lodash (severity High, in KEV, EPSS 0.30; upgrade lodash to 4.17.21).","4 open findings are rated Critical. A build gate set to fail on critical would stop 3 of them from shipping until they are fixed or formally accepted."],"assumptions":["The known-exploited and exploit-likelihood data is a demo snapshot, not the live catalogs.","Code search shows where packages are mentioned, not whether the vulnerable code runs."]}
